ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at approximately 8-10% of total fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark contiguous region across both lobes, punctuated by discrete high-contrast white circular clusters (rosettes) located primarily in the central and lower-lateral zones of the fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an acute angle and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations along the trailing edge boundary with varying pixel-amplitudes (5-20 pixels), most pronounced on the inner lobe regions adjacent to the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves along the trailing edges of both lobes tapering to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the dark pigment of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible calcified barnacle clusters concentrated on the distal tips and leading edge margins; widespread rosette-pattern scarring on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and non-uniform trailing edge serration pattern.
